reproduction.description: A self-contained Python script that demonstrates this defect. Run from the repository root with the project importable, it must FAIL (raise, or exit non-zero) because of this defect, and would stop failing if the defect were fixed. No pytest, no fixtures, no command-line arguments. Do not swallow the error - let it surface. This is how the finding is scored: it is executed, and a finding whose script does not fail is not counted.
